rules: Owner rambles are valid input; normalize them without forcing project-management language.
An explicit owner correction may update derived execution locks, but cannot silently change Product or other canonical business policy.
Before paid image generation, assert exact OpenArt project ID, model/mode, reference count and reference IDs.
No generated output may become a future reference unless the owner explicitly accepts it as a new master.
One proof before batch generation whenever the visual master or rendering pipeline changes.
Website hero static art and live UI are separate layers.
Ads are final rasters; their visual WhatsApp CTA is separate from Meta's clickable CTA.
No provider mutation, ad publication, spend, merge, deployment or private-client access from a creative planning turn without separate authority.
